examples.text: atha kho kosinārakā mallā bhagavato sarīrāni satt'āhaṃ sandh'āgāre sattipañjaraṃ karitvā dhanupākāraṃ parikkhipāpetvā naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkariṃsu garuṃ kariṃsu mānesuṃ pūjesuṃ.
niyyānikaṃ vata buddhasāsanan'ti pasīditvā yojanikaṃ suvaṇṇacetiyaṃ kambalakañcukena parikkhipitvā tattha tattha rathacakkappamāṇehi suvaṇṇapadumehi alaṅ'kari.
sa kho so, bhikkhave, bālo idha pubbe ras'ādo idha pāpāni kammāni karitvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā tesaṃ sattānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati ye te sattā tiṇabhakkhā.
daḷhāya rajjuyā bandhitvā majjhe gaṇṭhiṃ karitvā ossajjeyya. atha kho, te, bhikkhave, chappāṇakā nānāvisayā nānāgocarā sakaṃ sakaṃ gocaravisayaṃ āviñcheyyuṃ
sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ katvā vāt'ātape visoseyya. vāt'ātape visosetvā agginā ḍaheyya. agginā ḍahetvā masiṃ kareyya. masiṃ karitvā mahāvāte vā ophuṇeyya nadiyā vā sīghasotāya pavāheyya.
puna caparaṃ, ambaṭṭha, idh'ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā imañ'c'eva anuttaraṃ vijjācaraṇasampadaṃ anabhisambhuṇamāno… gāmasāmantaṃ vā nigamasāmantaṃ vā agy'āgāraṃ karitvā aggiṃ paricaranto acchati.

20505.meaning1: having done; having made; having built

examples.text: kiṃ bhadante karitvāna, ko vā ācariyo tava, kassa sāsanam'āgamma, labbhate taṃ asokatā.
ten'eva so sugatim'upecca modati, sukhapphalaṃ kariya sukhāni vindati, sam'ojasā rasaharaṇī susaṇṭhitā, idh'āgato labhati rasaggas'aggitaṃ.
tā piṇḍāya caritvā, bhatt'atthaṃ kariya dhotapattāyo, rahitamhi sukhanisinnā, imā girā abbhudīresuṃ.

20507.meaning1: maintaining good relationships by deed and conduct

examples.text: dānam'pi c'atthacariyatañ'ca, piyavāditañ'ca samānattatañ'ca, kariyacariyasusaṅgahaṃ bahūnaṃ, anavamatena guṇena yāti saggaṃ.
tena kho pana samayena bhikkhunīnaṃ kammaṃ na kariyati.
uposathakammassa pattakallattaṃ viditvā idāni kariyamāno uposatho saṅghena anumānetabbo.

yo, bhikkhave, tathāgatena evaṃ ācikkhiyamāne desiyamāne paññapiyamāne paṭṭhapiyamāne vivariyamāne vibhajiyamāne uttānīkariyamāne na jānāti na passati tam'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, bālaṃ puthujjanaṃ andhaṃ acakkhukaṃ ajānantaṃ apassantaṃ kin'ti karomi!
yo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye, appamatto vihassati, pahāya jātisaṃsāraṃ, dukkhass'antaṃ karissati.
etañ'hi tumhe paṭipannā, dukkhass'antaṃ karissatha, akkhāto vo mayā maggo, aññāya sallakantanaṃ.

20513.grammar: fut, reflx 1st sg of karissati, trans (+acc)
20513.meaning1: I myself will do; I will make for myself
20513.commentary: (THa) karissaṃ n'āvarajjhissan'ti tam'ahaṃ dāni karissaṃ na virādhessaṃ, yath'ānusiṭṭhaṃ paṭipajjissāmi. (THa) na te karissaṃ vacanaṃ idāni'han'ti yadi'pi pubbe tava vase anuvattiṃ, idāni pana satthu ovādaṃ laddhakālato paṭṭhāya cittavasiko na bhavissāmi.

examples.text: arūpa dūraṅ'gama ekacāri, na te karissaṃ vacanaṃ idāni'haṃ, dukkhā hi kāmā kaṭukā mahabbhayā, nibbānam'ev'ābhimano carissaṃ.
avivādavaḍḍhanakariṃ sugiraṃ, bhinn'ānusandhijananiṃ abhaṇi, kalahaṃ janassa panudī samaṅgī, sahitehi nandati pamodati ca.

20516.commentary: (MNa) karoto na karīyati pāpan'ti yaṃkiñci pāpaṃ karomī'ti saññāya karotopi pāpaṃ na karīyati, n'atthi pāpaṃ. sattā pana karomā'ti evaṃsaññino hontī'ti attho.

examples.text: yañ'hi kiccaṃ apaviddhaṃ, akiccaṃ pana karīyati, unnaḷānaṃ pamattānaṃ, tesaṃ vaḍḍhanti āsavā.
kāmaṃ dāni imasmiṃ kāye pāṇisamphassā'pi kamantu, leḍḍusamphassā'pi kamantu, daṇḍasamphassā'pi kamantu, satthasamphassā'pi kamantu, karīyati h'idaṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanan'ti.
sace kho pana karoto karīyati pāpaṃ, na kho pan'āhaṃ kassaci pāpaṃ cetemi.

te kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamitvā paripuccheyyāsi pariggaṇheyyāsi, kiṃ, bhante, kusalaṃ, kiṃ akusalaṃ, kiṃ sāvajjaṃ, kiṃ anavajjaṃ, kiṃ sevitabbaṃ, kiṃ na sevitabbaṃ, kiṃ me karīyamānaṃ dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya assa, kiṃ vā pana me karīyamānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya assā'ti?
yaṃ kiñci, rāhula, ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ… antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā pathavīdhātu
disvāna taṇhaṃ aratiṃ ragañ'ca, n'āhosi chando api methunasmiṃ, kim'ev'idaṃ muttakarīsapuṇṇaṃ, pādā'pi naṃ samphusituṃ na icche.

20522.meaning2: square measure of land (which may be nearly an acre)

examples.text: rattin'divaṃ so gaṅgāya, vuyhamāno mah'odake, ravanto karuṇaṃ ravaṃ, majjhe gaṅgāya gacchati.

evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, khattiyakulā ce'pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma, evaṃ mettaṃ karuṇaṃ muditaṃ upekkhaṃ bhāvetvā labhati ajjhattaṃ vūpasamaṃ.
seyyathā'pi nāma ekaṃ puggalaṃ duggataṃ durūpetaṃ disvā karuṇāyeyya, evam'eva sabbasatte karuṇāya pharatī'ti

20531.meaning1: liberation of the mind by compassion; emancipation of the heart by sympathy

examples.text: nissaraṇañ'h'etaṃ, āvuso, vihesāya yadidaṃ karuṇācetovimuttī'ti.
hitvā mamattaṃ manujesu brahme, ekodibhūto karuṇ'ādhimutto, nirāmagandho virato methunasmā, etthaṭṭhito ettha ca sikkhamāno, pappoti macco amataṃ brahmalokan'ti.

20534.meaning1: cultivation of compassion; development of kindness (towards unfortunate beings)

examples.text: karuṇaṃ bhāvetu'kāmena pana nikkaruṇatāya ādīnavaṃ karuṇāya ca ānisaṃsaṃ paccavekkhitvā karuṇābhāvanā ārabhitabbā.
ayaṃ karuṇābhāvanāya vitthārakathā.

20535.meaning1: devoted to the development of compassion; engaged in the cultivation of kindness (towards unfortunate beings)

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe karuṇābhāvan'ānuyogam'anuyuttā viharanti, evarūpā'pi, bhikkhave, santi bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe.

20536.meaning1: with great ocean-like compassion; deeply compassionate

20538.meaning1: pities; feels sorry (for); feels compassion (for); has kindness (for unfortunate beings)

examples.text: kathañ'ca bhikkhu karuṇāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati? seyyathā'pi nāma ekaṃ puggalaṃ duggataṃ durūpetaṃ disvā karuṇāyeyya, evam'eva sabbasatte karuṇāya pharatī'ti
añña'd'atthu, ayaṃ varāko idāni marissati, yaṃ yadeva hi ayaṃ padaṃ nikkhipati, tena tena santike maraṇassa hotī'ti taṃ jano karuṇāyati.

20539.meaning1: pitying; feeling compassion (for); having kindness (for unfortunate beings)

examples.text: anusāsa brahme karuṇāyamāno, vivekadhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, yath'āhaṃ ākāso'va abyāpajjamāno, idh'eva santo asito careyyaṃ.

sabbapaṭhamaṃ tāva kiñci'd'eva karuṇāyitabbarūpaṃ paramakicchappattaṃ duggataṃ durūpetaṃ kapaṇapurisaṃ… disvā, kicchaṃ vat'āyaṃ satto āpanno, app'eva nāma imamhā dukkhā mucceyyā'ti karuṇā pavattetabbā.
taṃ alabhantena sukhito'pi pāpakārī puggalo vajjhena upametvā karuṇāyitabbo.

20542.meaning1: having taken pity (on); having felt compassion (for); having sympathized (with); having had kindness (for unfortunate beings)

examples.text: evaṃ taṃ puggalaṃ karuṇāyitvā tato paraṃ eten'eva upāyena piyapuggale, tato majjhatte, tato verimhī'ti anukkamena karuṇā pavattetabbā.
evaṃ sabbathā'pi karuṇāyitvā vuttanayen'eva attani piyapuggale majjhatte verimhī'ti catūsu janesu sīmāsambhedaṃ katvā

20543.meaning1: accompanied by compassion; full of pity; full of kindness (for unfortunate beings)

examples.text: so karuṇāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ.
kathañ'ca bhikkhu karuṇāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati? seyyathā'pi nāma ekaṃ puggalaṃ duggataṃ durūpetaṃ disvā karuṇāyeyya, evam'eva sabbasatte karuṇāya pharatī'ti

20544.meaning1: with a heart cooled by compassion
20544.meaning2: with a heart cooled by compassion
20544.commentary: (DNt) karuṇāya sītalaṃ karuṇāsītalaṃ, karuṇāsītalaṃ hadayaṃ assā'ti karuṇāsītalahadayo, taṃ karuṇāsītalahadayaṃ.

examples.text: karuṇāsītalahadayaṃ, paññāpajjotavihatamohatamaṃ, sanar'āmaralokagaruṃ, vande sugataṃ gativimuttaṃ.

20547.commentary: (DNa) karuṇe'dhimutto'ti karuṇājhāne adhimutto, taṃ jhānaṃ nibbattetvā'ti attho. (CPa) etaṃ ekodibhāvaṃ karuṇābrahmavihāravasena dassento karuṇe'dhimutto'ti āha. karuṇajjhāne adhimutto, taṃ jhānaṃ nibbattetvā'ti attho.

examples.text: hitvā mamattaṃ manujesu brahme, ekodibhūto karuṇe'dhimutto, nirāmagandho virato methunasmā, etthaṭṭhito ettha ca sikkhamāno, pappoti macco amataṃ brahmalokan'ti.

20548.meaning1: name of a group of deities
20548.meaning2: name of a group of deities

examples.text: sukkā karumhā aruṇā, āguṃ veghanasā saha, odātagayhā pāmokkhā, āguṃ devā vicakkhaṇā.
vāḷamigasaṅghasevitaṃ, kuñjaramattakareṇuloḷitaṃ, asahāyikā gantum'icchasi, rahitaṃ bhiṃsanakaṃ mahāvanaṃ.
saṃvijjanti kho pana me kule bhogā, sakkā bhogā ca bhuñjituṃ puññāni ca kātuṃ. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjeyyaṃ puññāni ca kareyyan'ti.
khurapariyantena ce'pi cakkena yo imissā pathaviyā pāṇe ekaṃ maṃsakhalaṃ ekaṃ maṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya, atthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, atthi pāpassa āgamo.

20552.meaning1: could be done; should be made

examples.text: app'eva nām'āhaṃ uttari manussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesaṃ sacchikareyyan'ti.

20553.commentary: (UDa) karerī'ti varuṇarukkhassa nāmaṃ. so kira gandhakuṭiyā maṇḍapassa sālāya ca antare hoti, tena gandhakuṭī'pi karerikuṭikā'ti vuccati, maṇḍapo'pi sālā'pi karerimaṇḍalamāḷo'ti. (THa) karerimālāvitatā'ti varuṇarukkhapantīhi samāgatā. kālavaṇṇapupphehi otthaṭā'ti'pi vadanti.
20553.notes: this seems like a more likely candidate than Saccopetalum tomentosum

examples.text: karerimālāvitatā, bhūmibhāgā manoramā, kuñjar'ābhirudā rammā, te selā ramayanti maṃ.

20554.meaning1: karira tree hut; small residence near the karira trees
20554.meaning2: karira tree hut, hut near the karira trees
20554.commentary: (DNa) karerikuṭikāyan'ti karerī'ti varuṇarukkhassa nāmaṃ, karerimaṇḍapo tassā kuṭikāya dvāre ṭhito, tasmā karerikuṭikā'ti vuccati, yathā kosambarukkhassa dvāre ṭhitattā kosambakuṭikā'ti.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme karerikuṭikāyaṃ.

20555.meaning2: karira tree hall, hall near the karira trees
20555.sanskrit: kharva? , karavalli? , karavelli?, kastūri? + maṇḍala + maṇḍapa

20556.meaning1: circular pavilion by the karira tree
20556.meaning2: circular pavilion by the karira tree
20556.commentary: (DNa) karerimaṇḍalamāḷe'ti tass'eva karerimaṇḍapassa avidūre katāya nisīdanasālāya. so kira karerimaṇḍapo gandhakuṭikāya ca sālāya ca antare hoti, tasmā gandhakuṭī'pi karerikuṭikā'pi sālā'pi, karerimaṇḍalamāḷo'ti vuccati.

examples.text: atha kho sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ karerimaṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttā dhammī kathā udapādi, iti'pi pubbenivāso, iti'pi pubbenivāso'ti.

20557.meaning1: forms a close relationship (with); makes an intimate connection (with); gets close (to)

examples.text: tasmā hi te sukhino vītasokā, ye mātugāmehi caranti nissaṭā, etaṃ sivaṃ uttamam'ābhipatthayaṃ, na mātugāmehi kareyya santhavan'ti.

20558.synonym: abhisaṅkharoti, ācarati, kubbati, carati, pakubbati, paṭipajjati, samācarati

examples.text: daharā ca apāpikā c'asi, kiṃ te pabbajjā karissati, nikkhipa kāsāyacīvaraṃ, ehi ramāma supupphite vane.
sace te, kesi, assadammo saṇhena vinayaṃ na upeti, pharusena vinayaṃ na upeti, saṇhapharusena vinayaṃ na upeti, kin'ti naṃ karosī'ti?
passāmi loke sadhane manusse, laddhāna vittaṃ na dadanti mohā, luddhā dhanaṃ sannicayaṃ karonti, bhiyyo'va kāme abhipatthayanti.
so taṃ thūṇaṃ khaṇḍ'ākhaṇḍikaṃ chindeyya. khaṇḍ'ākhaṇḍikaṃ chetvā phāleyya. phāletvā sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ kareyya. sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ katvā vāt'ātape visoseyya. vāt'ātape visosetvā agginā ḍaheyya.
seyyathā'pi, poṭṭhapāda, puriso cātumahāpathe nisseṇiṃ kareyya pāsādassa ārohaṇāya.

20561.grammar: prp, masc dat sg of karonta, trans (+acc)

examples.text: karoto cīyati pāpaṃ, cirarattāya antaka, māra nibbinda buddhamhā, āsaṃ m'ākāsi bhikkhusu.
abhittharetha kalyāṇe, pāpā cittaṃ nivāraye, dandhañ'hi karoto puññaṃ, pāpasmiṃ ramatī mano.

20566.grammar: imp, reflx 1st pl of karoti, trans (+acc)
20566.meaning1: we must do; let us make; let us act; we must perform
20566.meaning2: we must do; let us make; let us act; we must perform
20566.commentary: (JAa) vigaticchāna namo karomase'ti tasmā ye vigaticchā buddh'ādayo, tesaṃ mayaṃ namakkāraṃ karomā'ti.

examples.text: yaṃ labhati na tena tussati, yañ'ca pattheti laddhaṃ hīḷeti, icchā hi anantagocarā, vigaticchāna namo karomase'ti.
ye kho pamattā viharanti, te me sandhāya bhāsitaṃ, ye appamattā viharanti, namo tesaṃ karom'ahan'ti.
pāde pakkhālayitvāna, udakesu karom'ahaṃ, pād'odakañ'ca disvāna, thalato ninnam'āgataṃ.
dukkhan'ti khandhe paṭipassa yoniso, yato ca dukkhaṃ samudeti taṃ jaha, idh'eva dukkhassa karohi antaṃ, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
so karohi dīpam'attano, khippaṃ vāyama paṇḍito bhava, niddhantamalo anaṅgaṇo, dibbaṃ ariyabhūmiṃ upehisi.

20574.commentary: (VINa) veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe'ti… kalandakānañ'c'ettha nivāpaṃ adaṃsu tena kalandakanivāpa'ti vuccati.

20575.meaning2: locality where the squirrels are fed

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.

20576.commentary: (VINa) kalandagāmo'ti kalandakā vuccanti kāḷakā, tesaṃ vasena laddhanāmo gāmo.

20577.commentary: (VINa) kalandaputto'ti gāmavasena laddhanāmassa rājasammatassa cattālīsakoṭivibhavassa kalandaseṭṭhino putto. yasmā pana tasmiṃ gāme aññe'pi kalandanāmakā manussā atthi, tasmā kalandaputto'ti vatvā puna seṭṭhiputto'ti vuttaṃ.

20579.commentary: (MNa) kalabhāgampī'ti satimaṃ kalaṃ sahassimaṃ kalaṃ satasahassimaṃ vā kalaṃ upagacchatī'ti'pi vattabbataṃ na upeti. examples.text: saṅkham'pi na upeti upanidhim'pi na upeti kalabhāgam'pi na upeti mahāpathaviṃ upanidhāya bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito'ti.

tassa parikkhāraṃ nikkaḍḍhati vā nikkaḍḍhāpeti vā, bhaṇḍanakārakaṃ kalahakārakaṃ vivādakārakaṃ bhassakārakaṃ saṅghe adhikaraṇakārakaṃ nikkaḍḍhati vā nikkaḍḍhāpeti vā, tassa parikkhāraṃ nikkaḍḍhati vā nikkaḍḍhāpeti vā

20592.commentary: (MNa) hatthaparāmās'ādi-vasena matthakaṃ patto kalaho jāto etesan'ti kalahajātā.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ bhaṇḍanajātānaṃ kalahajātānaṃ vivād'āpannānaṃ upassutiṃ tiṭṭheyya yaṃ ime bhaṇissanti, taṃ sossāmī'ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ.
tena kho pana samayena bhikkhūnaṃ bhaṇḍanajātānaṃ kalahajātānaṃ vivād'āpannānaṃ viharataṃ bahuṃ assāmaṇakaṃ ajjhāciṇṇaṃ hoti bhāsitaparikkantaṃ.

cha kho'me, gahapatiputta, ādīnavā surā-meraya-majja-ppamādaṭṭhān'ānuyoge. sandiṭṭhikā dhanajāni, kalahappavaḍḍhanī, rogānaṃ āyatanaṃ, akittisañjananī, kopīnanidaṃsanī, paññāya dubbalikaraṇī'tv'eva chaṭṭhaṃ padaṃ bhavati.

20599.meaning1: fallen into quarrels, disputes and arguments

examples.text: te kalahaviggahavivād'āpannā aññam'aññaṃ pāṇīhi'pi upakkamanti, leḍḍūhi'pi upakkamanti, daṇḍehi'pi upakkamanti, satthehi'pi upakkamanti. te tattha maraṇam'pi nigacchanti, maraṇamattam'pi dukkhaṃ.
